title: STOCK MARKET CRASH SIGNALS CONFIRM! BUT... How does it go wrong? SPY QQQ IWM
speaker: Money Making Market host

macro_themes.view: Daily/weekly MACD, RSI and price confirm a lower high on SPY, but similar bearish confirmations have failed before, so stay open to a bullish 'trap'.
VIX has held divergences and could see weeks of rising volatility if the 2-hour confirms up.

calls.condition: Bearish while the 2-hour MACD keeps rolling; if the 2-hour MACD curls up near the center line, the bearish signal fails and a higher low / move up is in play. A drop to the daily expected move low (755.40) would set in continued downside.
calls.reason: Daily confirmed down with MACD crossover, lower high in price/MACD/RSI; possible weekly divergence confirming. Daily expected move 755.40-769.86.
calls.quote: everything here on the macro scale is saying, "Watch out. This could head to the downside."

calls.condition: If the 30-minute flushes, QQQ can go down to 736.7; if a higher low sets and confirms up, flip bullish for a 748.87 test.
calls.reason: 30-minute confirming down but 2-hour still positive and daily can withstand a pullback; QQQ posture differs from SPY.
calls.quote: you can go all the way down to 7367, but we'll watch for any kind of higher low set

calls.condition: Bulls only convincing above 296 (via squeeze into higher low or divergence); a 30-minute divergence could give a bounce toward 280.98, otherwise risk of flush to 274.80 and lower.
calls.reason: 6 of 7 negative weeks, daily extremely negative and oversold; 2-hour divergences intact but 30-minute rolling negative.
calls.quote: I'm not really confident in them unless they can take out that 296 level

calls.condition: Conditional on the 2-hour VIX MACD confirming up; a quick 30-minute curl down near the center line would mean the volatility push fails.
calls.reason: VIX daily curling up, higher low held, 2-hour divergences confirmed; deep MACD though, so failure possible.
calls.quote: This means that we could see weeks of volatility. We could see a weekly push in volatility.

notes: No date spoken; host references getting October monthly expected moves 'tomorrow', suggesting recording on Sep 30 after close (listing approx 2026-10-01). QQQ levels transcribed as '7367' and '74887', interpreted as 736.7 and 748.87. SPY 700/695 mentioned as a question ('revisit that 700, 695 level?'), recorded as support not target. Invalidation is indicator-based (2-hour MACD curling up), not a price.
